title: An Operationalization of Opaque Serial Depth
abstract: arXiv:2611.17495v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) is currently a valuable tool for overseeing AI models, but some architectural shifts could significantly reduce CoT monitorability. We operationalize a measure that serves as a proxy for the amount of unverbalized serial cognition a model can perform, as a specific instantiation of the notion of opaque serial depth: roughly, the length of the longest path through a model's computation that does not pass through an interpretable bottleneck. Our main contribution is a particular standard for what counts as such a bottleneck. We define natural-language-rooted (NL-rooted) nodes as nodes that were initialized from a pre-training prior to produce human-understandable outputs, whose output space has not been expanded beyond that prior, and whose outputs the model has not been modified to interpret as a different type of data. By construction, the resulting measure, NLS depth, can be adjudicated before training from an arc

translated_title: 不透明串行深度的可操作化定义
translated_abstract: 思维链目前是监督AI模型的一个宝贵工具，但某些架构上的转变可能会显著降低思维链的可监控性。我们操作化了一种度量指标，作为模型能够执行的非言语化串行认知量的代理，这是“不透明串行深度”概念的一个具体实例化——大致而言，即模型计算中不经过可解释瓶颈的最长路径的长度。我们的主要贡献是提出了一个判定何种节点可算作此类瓶颈的特定标准。我们将根植于自然语言的节点定义为：从产生人类可理解输出的预训练先验中初始化而来的节点，其输出空间未被扩展至超出该先验的范围，且模型未被修改以将其输出解释为不同类型的数据。通过构建方式，由此得到的度量指标——NLS深度，可以在训练之前基于架构进行判定……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文将“不透明串行深度”操作化为NLS深度指标，通过定义“自然语言根植节点”作为可解释瓶颈的标准，为衡量模型的非言语化串行认知能力提供了可在训练前判定架构的依据，以应对架构变化可能削弱思维链可监控性的风险。
en_tdlr: This paper operationalizes "opaque serial depth" as NLS depth by defining NL-rooted nodes as the standard for interpretable bottlenecks, providing a pre-training-adjudicable proxy for a model's unverbalized serial cognition in response to architectural shifts that could undermine CoT monitorability.
